verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's GitHub README claims 'no proxy headaches, just clean data' implying built-in anti-bot/proxy handling, but a hands-on community comment directly contradicts this, stating Firecrawl 'doesn't have proxy service which is the heart of any crawler and scraper.' No documentation describes a retry-through-proxy-chain mechanism or exposes proxy configuration/rotation controls. missing for 10: explicit docs on proxy chain retry logic, evidence of configurable proxy pools, independent confirmation the anti-bot bypass actually rotates proxies on block.
